name: POST /api/public/device-checks - free device check from the product-code page
description: A visitor can run a free device check from the product-code page (F6.1). No sign-in; FDA data only, no AI. Body: productCode, description (10-2000 characters), contactConsent (default false), email (required when contactConsent), and a hidden honeypot 'website' that people leave empty. Returns the code's class, regulation and likely pathway, the five most recent-first clearances under the code whose device names best match the description (share of the device name's words found in the description; high, medium or low; an estimate to start predicate research, not a finding of substantial equivalence), recall events with FDA status open and root causes, receipt-to-decision days, sources, and whether the visitor asked to be contacted. Stored: product code, time and an HMAC of the IP for rate limiting; the email and description only with consent (enforced by a database CHECK). DEVICE_CHECKS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR (default 10) per hashed IP, then 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After.

errorCases.when: missing or short description, bad product code, consent without email, malformed email or an unknown field

errorCases.notReproducibleReason: Test environments raise DEVICE_CHECKS_PER_IP_PER_HOUR so suites do not trip it.
